name: time-tracker-invoicing
description: Clock billable time on the note you have open, total it by client, and turn unbilled hours into a markdown or PDF invoice. Fully local.

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:ci
scripts.test:ci: node tests/license.test.mjs && node tests/manifest-contract.test.mjs && node --test tests/billing.test.mjs tests/pdf.test.mjs tests/migrate.test.mjs tests/writer.test.mjs tests/reconcile.test.mjs tests/plugin.test.mjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Israel Avila
